title: Smile and Hymn
author: Ulyana Almeida
blurb: Ada Montrose, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
